name: cweeperde-skills
description: Claude skills by cweeper. Each plugin holds one skill and installs on its own.

plugins.name: interview
plugins.description: Claude asks structured multiple-choice questions, each with a recommended default, before it starts a task, then recaps the plan for your approval.

plugins.name: writing-unslop
plugins.description: Finds and removes AI slop in writing: inflated, vague or unverified text and typical LLM phrasing, in prose, docs, code comments and commit messages.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Writes a short HANDOFF.md with the verified state, decisions, open problems and next steps, so a later session can resume the work, and resumes from one.
